name: Todos
desc: Create tasks for project members to take actions, useful for approvals, reviews, and manual actions performed by humans

actions.name: createTodo
actions.description: Creates a todo for a user, requiring them to respond or take action.

actions.name: wait_for_approval
actions.description: Pauses the flow and wait for the approval from the user

actions.name: createTodoAndWait
actions.description: Creates a todo for a user and wait for their response or take action.
